errors.evidence: The tick marks on the x-axis are placed at January and July for each year, which represents a semi-annual interval, not monthly.
The text “Januar 2015 = 100” is part of the legend description for two of the data series. It is not a label for the x-axis, which is labeled with dates.

errors.text_span: Die blaue Linie repräsentiert den gesetzlichen Mindestlohn
errors.evidence: The line representing the statutory minimum wage ('Gesetzlicher Mindestlohn') is purple, not blue.
The purple line representing the statutory minimum wage is at a value of approximately 150.5 in January 2025.

errors.text_span: der im August 2023 einen Höchststand von etwa 138 erreicht
errors.evidence: The value of the purple line in August 2023 is approximately 141, not 138. Furthermore, this is not its peak; the line reaches a higher value later.
The line being described is light blue, not yellow.
The light blue line begins at an index value of 100 in January 2015, as indicated by both the plot and its legend entry 'Index (Januar 2015 = 100)'.
The light blue line does not extend to 2025. It stops around the end of 2022 at a value of approximately 118.

errors.text_span: der sich im Februar 2023 auf etwa 133 erhöht
errors.evidence: The light blue line does not reach a value of 133. It ends around the start of 2023 at an approximate value of 118.
The line being described is dark blue, not grey.

errors.text_span: die zunächst mit 141,2 im Oktober 2022 beginnt
errors.evidence: The dark blue line does not begin in October 2022. It starts on the chart around July 2022 at a value of approximately 140. The legend entry 'Oktober 2022 = 141,2' specifies the base for its index, not the starting point of the line on the plot.

errors.text_span: und im Januar 2025 bei etwa 141 liegt
errors.evidence: The dark blue line does not extend to January 2025. It stops around January 2024 at a value of approximately 155.

errors.text_span: und sich über den gesamten Zeitraum hinweg in einem vergleichsweise gleichmäßigen Bereich befindet
errors.evidence: This is inaccurate. The dark blue line only exists for a small portion of the overall time period (mid-2022 to early 2024) and shows a clear upward trend from ~140 to ~155, not a 'gleichmäßigen' (steady/uniform) level.
The description of the purple line ('Gesetzlicher Mindestlohn') omits its most prominent feature: that it is a step function, increasing in discrete steps rather than continuously.
